svg.text: Monstrous Moonshine · Prime Shells, Folded by q-Grade
Eleven McKay–Thompson series in one diagram. Rings = q-grade n (Vₙ), expanding outward; each brand-new prime is drawn ONCE,
on the ring where it first appears in ANY series. A prime needed by several series is one striped bead – its colours stacked, never duplicated.
ring = q-grade n where the prime
FIRST appears in any of the series
a bead's stripes = every series that needs it
106 distinct primes, de-duplicated: each drawn once on its global first-appearance ring. q-grades: 1A up to q¹⁰, all others up to q¹⁵.
Every bead set is machine-checked in Lean 4 / Mathlib (RequestProject/MoonshineFold.lean: folded_shells, foldNewPrimes_disjoint) — no sorry, standard axioms only; class 3A matches OEIS A030197.
